Coverage_Description: Outpatient medical cover via panel network in Hong Kong, designated Mainland GBA cities and Macau: GP face-to-face/online consultations (with medication delivery), Chinese medicine; subject to policy-year visit limits, co-payment and coinsurance
pricing: Annual premium table (HKD, effective 14 Apr 2025) shows listed figures from HK$2,480/year to HK$17,500/year (including HK$5,380, HK$6,480, HK$3,050, HK$6,600, HK$8,100 and HK$4,800).
customer requirement: No health underwriting/medical exam; for Family Plan A/B, policy owner and insured must be the same person
price structure: Annual premium payment in HKD; premiums are non-guaranteed and may be adjusted at renewal (age, claims, medical inflation, persistency, expenses)
additional informations: Online GP co-payment is waived when no drug prescription is issued; Family Plan A/B uses one premium for unlimited family members; psychiatric consultation has 180-day (mental illness) and 2-year (perinatal depression) waiting periods
